fields.System.Title: Test execution
fields.System.Description:
## Test checklist
- [ ] [Functional] Valid invoice submission creates an approved invoice

expected_patch.value:
- Happy path: Valid invoice submission creates an approved invoice
- Edge case: Invoice with Amount equal to minimum 0 is accepted
- Error handling: Invoice with Amount below 0 is rejected with message Amount must be at least 0
- State transition: Submitting a valid Draft invoice moves it to Approved without changing InvoiceNumber
